about: Commands Agent Drive may use in experiments on this repository. Drive's planner picks a metric and checks by name; it cannot run anything not listed here.

metrics.name: rounds per task
metrics.about: Mean model rounds the coding agent needs to answer 8 read-only questions about this repo (bench/agent-tasks.json) with the configured provider model. Captures how efficiently the agent searches and reads. Also reports correctness, tool calls, re-reads and input tokens.
